title: N-Grammer: Augmenting Transformers with latent n-grams
summary: Applies N-Grammer — our open-source Transformer variant augmented with n-grams built from a discrete latent representation of the text sequence — to cut training and inference cost in the language portfolio, validated on C4 language modeling and SuperGLUE classification against Transformer and Primer baselines, with a Jax API release for flax and haiku.
